title: 微调是否会撤销激活引导？行为恢复但权重编辑未逆转
summary: 该研究探讨了嵌入语言模型权重的激活引导在后续微调（SFT/RLHF）下的稳定性。行为上，引导效果随训练数据方向变化，拒绝抑制平均损失64%；机制上，权重编辑几乎未被破坏（向量恢复ρ=0.004，更新方向余弦0.074）。结论：嵌入式引导机制耐久但功能脆弱，需下游训练后重新验证。
summary_en: This study examines the stability of activation steering embedded in LLM weights under subsequent fine-tuning (SFT/RLHF). Behaviorally, steering degrades with optimization pressure, e.g., refusal suppression loses 64% on average; mechanistically, weight edits survive (vector recovery ρ=0.004, cosine 0.074). Embedded steering is mechanistically durable but functionally vulnerable, requiring re-validation.
